card.name: Just before the word diarrhea
card.fires_on: The hyphen-and-start of "diarrheal" in "anti-diarrheal", the first piece of "Diarrhea" in headings, and linking words right before "diarrhea". It predicts that "diarrhea" comes next.

modes.label: Anti-diarrheal
modes.description: The "-di" piece after "anti" that begins "anti-diarrheal" treatment or medication.
modes.example: Advise patients to start anti<<-di>>arrheal treatment, increase oral fluids

modes.label: Capitalized Diarrhea
modes.description: The opening piece of "Diarrhea" in a section heading or grade table.
modes.example: 5.4 Severe or Persistent<< Di>>arrhea Grade 3 or 4

modes.label: Linking word before diarrhea
modes.description: A small word like "or" or "from" in a list of symptoms or fluid loss, right before "diarrhea".
modes.example: Extensive fluid loss<< from>> diarrhea or vomiting may require correction of electroly

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "diarrhea" (also in Chinese) as the next word.
card.plain: It lights up when the next word is likely to be "diarrhea", most often in "anti-diarrheal".
